title: From flow to evidence
voice: Playwright Studio. Turn your test flows into real evidence.
caption: A complete QA workflow. No external AI API required.

title: Choose your application
voice: Start with your application URL. Open a project, or choose Try demo.
caption: Application URL  •  Open project  •  Try demo

title: Select a login profile
voice: Select a role. Save its credentials with Edit, then choose that profile.
caption: Role → Username / email → Password → Save profile

title: Write steps in order
voice: Write each action in order. Log in, click, fill, select, and check. Verify text and API results.
caption: Quote labels and values. Separate actions with semicolons.

title: Choose the session policy
voice: Open Advanced settings. Choose a fresh or saved session. Set a success marker, or inspect a manual session.
caption: Fresh = clean context  •  Saved = dedicated profile  •  Manual capture = inspection only

title: Select your deliverables
voice: Choose your languages and frameworks. Include a test plan, and set the output folder.
caption: Four frameworks  •  Optional test plan  •  Your output folder

title: Run the real workflow
voice: Click Run test. The browser follows your steps, creates the task, and verifies the response. This is real footage.
caption: Actual browser recording from this demo run

title: Read every step outcome
voice: Review every step. Failures stop dependent actions, so the results reflect what actually happened.
caption: Passed, failed and skipped outcomes reflect actual execution.

title: Inspect the full report
voice: Open the full report. Filter results and expand a case. Advisory plans are clearly marked as not run.
caption: Filter → Expand a case → Review the step results

title: See what actually happened
voice: Inspect screenshots and video. Review API responses, or download the trace. Evidence stays with each report.
caption: Screenshots  •  Video  •  API status  •  Playwright trace

title: Take the project forward
voice: Review the test plan and generated files. Reopen for another run, or execute the exported suites.
caption: Test plan + source files  •  Numbered runs  •  CLI execution

title: Stop the login loop
voice: Hmm. A login loop? Check redirects and responses. Stop once, and skip dependent steps.
caption: Login → Dashboard → Login  /  Stop + diagnose  /  No automatic retry

title: Set up. Run. Review. Reuse.
voice: Playwright Studio. Ready for your next test.
caption: A complete workflow, from setup to reusable tests.
